title: Import owned characters from HoYoLAB
intro: Imports the weapons, artifacts, talent levels and more of your owned characters from your HoYoLAB Battle Chronicle, so you can use them in the party settings. The imported data is stored only in this browser and is never sent anywhere.

ext.note: The extension only communicates with HoYoLAB (hoyolab.com). Neither the extension nor this app reads the value of your login cookie.

install.intro: Install the extension in Chrome in 5 steps (only once; about 3-5 minutes).
install.s1Body: Download the extension zip file with the button below.
install.s2Body: Right-click the downloaded zip and choose "Extract All". Extract it to a place you will not delete, such as Documents.
install.s2Note: Chrome keeps using this extracted folder after installation. Do not delete or move it.
install.s3Body: Press the button below. An empty new tab opens and the address of the extensions page is copied. Click the address bar of the new tab, paste (Ctrl+V) and press Enter. When the extensions page opens, turn on "Developer mode" at the top right.
install.s3Button: Open a new tab and copy {{address}}
install.s4Body: Click "Load unpacked" at the top left and choose the folder you extracted in step 2 (the one that contains manifest.json). It worked if "Genshin Rotation Planner - HoYoLAB import" appears in the list.
install.s5Body: Reload with the button below, then open "Import" again. If "Extension detected" appears, you are done.
install.trouble1: Still "Extension not found": check that you reloaded in step 5 and that the extension switch is on in the extensions page.
install.trouble2: "Manifest file is missing": if there is another folder with the same name inside the extracted folder, choose the inner one.
install.trouble3: "This extension is disabled" (for example after restarting Chrome): turn the switch on again in the extensions page.
install.trouble4: Edge works the same way (address: edge://extensions), but it has only been tested in Chrome.
install.update: To update: extract the new zip over the same folder and press the extension's "Update" button in the extensions page.

uid.label: Genshin UID
uid.loginHint: Before importing, log in to HoYoLAB in this Chrome. You cannot import without logging in.
uid.hint: In the browser where you are logged in to HoYoLAB, make your Battle Chronicle character details public.

import.noExtension: No response from the extension. Check that it is installed
import.errorPrivate: Your Battle Chronicle is not public. In the HoYoLAB settings, make the character details public ({{message}})
import.errorLogin: You are not logged in to HoYoLAB. Log in to HoYoLAB in this browser ({{message}})

list.title: Imported owned characters
list.clearConfirm: This deletes the imported owned-character data. Values already applied to a party stay as they are. Continue?
list.noMaster: This character is not in the app's data, so it cannot be added to a party
list.ambiguous: Could not determine the ascension phase (treated as not ascended)
list.noWeaponMaster: The weapon is not in the app's data
list.noSetMaster: The artifact set is not in the app's data
